_doc: Generic clothing / hair phrases from Juniper's 'How could you tell?' reasons (2026-11-25). No names. Text side for run_clothing_clue_eval.py; regenerate vectors with scripts/generate_clothing_phrase_vectors.py.
neutral: a photo of a person walking

puffy_purple_jacket: a person wearing a puffy purple jacket
a person in a purple down jacket
a person in a purple puffer coat
tight_ponytail: a person with their hair in a tight ponytail
a person with a high ponytail
a woman with a slicked back ponytail
blue_denim_shirt: a person wearing a blue denim shirt
a person in a chambray shirt
a person in a jean shirt
shorts: a person wearing very short shorts
